# bunnynet_url_cache_purge (Action)

This action allows users to purge cache for a specific URL in the bunny.net infrastructure.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# purge all URLs under /assets/
action "bunnynet_url_cache_purge" "website-assets" {
  config {
    url = "https://www.example.com/assets/"
  }
}

# purge only /contact/, but not its sub-resources
action "bunnynet_url_cache_purge" "website-assets" {
  config {
    url        = "https://www.example.com/contact/"
    exact_path = true
  }
}

# purge all URLs prefixed with `/test-`
action "bunnynet_url_cache_purge" "website-assets" {
  config {
    url = "https://www.example.com/test-*"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `url` (String) The URL to be purged.

### Optional

- `exact_path` (Boolean) When true and the URL ends with '/', it purges only the exact path without adding a wildcard suffix. Only applies when the pull zone has IgnoreQueryStrings disabled.
